links.outcome: External validation of the forecasting model on independent episodes from a separate database
links.effect: Model developed on 614 episodes and externally validated on 206 independent episodes; 12-h IL-6 MAE 6.82 pg/mL, spike AUROC 0.814, 90% PI coverage 87.2%.
links.quote: External validation was performed on 206 independent episodes.

unlisted_practices: Safety-constrained offline reinforcement learning (conservative Q-learning) for drug dosing recommendations
Probabilistic forecasting with prediction intervals for inflammatory marker trajectories

screen.reason: Evaluated a safety-constrained offline reinforcement learning agent (CPQL) versus an unconstrained offline RL policy for propofol-ketamine dosing, directly measuring safety constraint violations and clinical stability.
